According to legend, Za Xiang was a tiny pandaren village that depended on its fishers and had no farmers or hunters. It was also the birth place of Xun who saved the town when an unnatural famine crept through the town as fish disappeared from the sea. The people of Za Xiang would come to depend on Xun but were forced to stop when Xun eventually perished fighting a monster of legend and freed the trapped fish in its cave. As these fish were the ancestors of the golden carp, a most common fish, it is assumed that the people of Za Xiang were able to return to the fishing life styles in peace.

's remains.]] Zallestrasza is a red drake, and an agent of the former Aspect Alexstrasza dispatched to Drustvar. There, she was tasked with finding the final resting place of the ancient green dragon Vadekius and ensuring that his remains could not be raised into undeath. Enlisting the aid of the Thornspeakers and a passing adventurer, Zallestrasza journeyed to Vadekius's Rest and began a ritual to cleanse the remains. They were soon attacked by Danir Emberlight, who sought to raise Vadekius himself, though the death knight was slain. The ritual complete, Zallestrasza departed to continue her business elsewhere. .]] .]] Zandali, also known as Troll or Zandalari, is the native language of all trolls. Like many languages, Zandali has many accents divided by regions. The Stranglethorn Vale accent is distinct enough that trolls can recognize it with only one word. Zandali is taught to the young of the Darkspear tribe, with Orcish being taught in addition. Although described as a guttural language, Zandali always has a melodious flow to it. The Hakkari refer to the language as "the old tongue" and do not converse in it. In World of Warcraft, Zandali is the secondary language spoken by the Darkspear trolls of the Horde. It appears to be named after Zandalar, where the early trolls first settled.

Zangarmarsh, once known as the Zangar Sea, is a hauntingly beautiful swamp covered with a forest of giant mushrooms. Though largely teeming with life, sections of the swamp have begun to die of late, and the sapient fungi of the region seek help in returning it to life. This zone is located in Outland to the west of Hellfire Peninsula. The marshes are the home of myriad varieties of predatory invertebrates and flora, including fungal giants, sporebats, and spore walkers.

Zarcsin is one of several possible demons that can be summoned when inserting 35 Apexis Shards into a Fel Crystal Prism found at either Forge Camp: Wrath or Forge Camp: Terror. He is mostly a tank and spank fight, but he does a fire cone AoE called Fel Flames that hits for roughly 700 damage every second for 3 or 4 seconds so keep him faced away from rest of the group. He enrages at 50% health.
Zealot Zath is a jungle troll found in Zul'Gurub during the High Priest Thekal encounter.
Zealot Lor'Khan is a jungle troll found in the Naze of Shirvallah in Zul'Gurub during the High Priest Thekal encounter.

Jonathan Brown (alias Zarhym, previous aliases Timbal and Batta) is a former Blizzard employee and a Community Manager for the US World of Warcraft forums. Brown is believed to have joined Blizzard in 2005, and was introduced to the community on the forums on June 13, 2008 by Eyonix. Zarhym is also found in-game on the Timeless Isle as a ghostly skull resembling Brown's forum avatar. Zarhym abruptly left Blizzard on Friday, March 10, 2016, with no official "goodbye thread" as is typical of departing community managers. His next career move was previously unknown, but he has since surfaced as a Community Manager with long-time friend Bashiok at [http://us.ncsoft.com/en/ NCSOFT West].
The Zangarmarsh Banner can be found in Twin Spire Ruins in Zangarmarsh.
Zanzil Hunters are ghouls found in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Zaza is a frost nymph located at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra.

The Zaxxis are a splinter group of ethereals from the Consortium led by that is siphoning off business and trade from their parent organization. They have cut deals recently with the Sunfury blood elves.
Zantasia is a blood elf inscription trainer located in the Court of the Sun and can be seen standing near the enchanting trainer.

Zanzil's minions, denoted by the Zanzil or Zanzili in their names, are a small group of jungle troll witch doctors and undead minions that follow Zanzil the Outcast. Zanzil and the witch doctors have unscrupulously poisoned creatures of many different races, causing the affected individuals to die and rise from the grave as Zanzil's undead minions. Trolls from several different tribes are only one small part of Zanzil's private undead army. Besides the jungle trolls, Zanzil's undead army consists of naga, ghouls, zombies, and skeletons. Zanzil also captured and mind-controlled the youngest son of Vol'jin, Yenniku. The Zanzil trolls had dealings with the Venture Company in Stranglethorn Vale,
Zaxxis Raiders are ethereals found southeast of Manaforge B'naar in the Netherstorm.
Zaxxis Stalkers are ethereals found southeast of Manaforge B'naar in the Netherstorm.
Zaxxis Ambushers are ethereals that continually spawn during It's a Fel Reaver, But with Heart in the Netherstorm.
Zandalarian Shadow Talisman is a quest reward from Zandalarian Shadow Talisman (1).
The Zandalarian Emissary is an elite Zandalari troll formerly found in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. He used to give the Spirit of Zandalar buff.

Zarbo Porkpatty is a goblin located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. He used to reside in Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar, but was moved to Azshara following the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy along with Karizi Porkpatty, who might be his wife. Despite still being titled as a cooking trainer, he no longer offers any services. His former position in Orgrimmar is now occupied by Feng Su.
Zapper Gnomes are henchmen of Bingham Gadgetspring. Along with Netgun Gnomes, they patrol the area around his hideout.
Zang'do is a jungle troll shaman in the service of the Earthen Ring. He is located at Firestone Point with a gigantic 'peace pipe' in front of him in Southern Barrens.
Zar'gil was a Tribal Elder of the Frostwolf clan in the canceled Warcraft Adventures: Lord of the Clans.

The Zandalari Troll Wars, also known as the Zandalari Wars or Zandalari Invasion, were local conflicts in Pandaria fought between the Zandalar tribe of trolls and the Pandaren Empire, 11,900 years before the First War. The Zandalari, allies of the mogu that the pandaren had previously overthrown, sought to claim large territories in Pandaria promised to them by the mogu, but the tide of war was turned when a pandaren girl named Jiang learned to befriend and ride the mighty cloud serpents, founding the Order of the Cloud Serpent and driving back the trolls.
Zandalari Shadow-Hunters are Zandalari trolls found in the Valley of Emperors, the Tomb of Shadows, and Tomb of Secrets in Kun-Lai Summit, trying to activate Frozen Tomb Guardians.
Zandalari Warriors are found in the Tomb of Conquerors in Kun-Lai Summit after completing the quest Lessons from History.
Zandalari Raptor-Lords were forest trolls found in Zouchin Province in Kun-Lai Summit.

Zandalari Prisoner is a captive Zandalari troll, being held by the Pandaren of Zouchin Village. He is a member of the Zandalari Invaders, and ends up giving crucial information about the Zandalari's plans on Pandaria.

The Zandalari Vanguard is the new name of mogu ruins in the Zouchin Province of northeastern Kun-Lai Summit, claimed by the Zandalari for use as a base to besiege Zouchin Village and buy time for whatever is taking place on the Isle of Reckoning to the north.
Zanzil's Formulation drops from Zanzil Witch Doctors in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Zay'hana is a jungle troll stable master located at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.
Zandalari Pterrorwings are pterrordax mounted by circling above a platform along the cliffside of Kun-Lai Summit.
Zandalari Stoneshields are Zandalari trolls located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Zandalari Prospects are Zandalari trolls located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Zandalari Spiritbinders are Zandalari trolls located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Zandalari Spiritweavers are Zandalari trolls located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.
Zandalari Speakers are Zandalari trolls located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder.

Zandalari Warbringers are members of the Zandalari/Mogu armies of Lei Shen, the Thunder King. They lead brigades of Zandalari trolls onto the shores of Pandaria to begin the invasion. They are accompanied by Silentstrike Pterrorwings.
Zandalari Warscouts are scouts of Lei Shen's army. They travel ahead of the main invasion force, spying inland for key points to attack.
Zandalari Soultwisters are Zandalari trolls found in Conqueror's Terrace on the Isle of Thunder.
Zandalari Spirit-Twisters are Zandalari trolls located in Stormsea Landing on the Isle of Thunder.
